choices.en: the demon captured the tang monk.

answer_evidence.quote: Below the ice the Tang Monk struggled as the demon carried him deep underwater.
"You all fell for my trick! I froze the river and waited for you to cross it. Once you were above me, I cracked the ice open. As soon as your friends leave, I will eat you and live forever!"
The demon went inside and locked the monk in a stone box.
He was holding a large hammer.

choices.zh: 他的力量在水下并不强。

choices.en: he didn't know how to swim.
he was scared of the demon.

answer_evidence.quote: "My powers aren't very strong underwater. You two must go down there and get the demon to come back up. I'll surprise him."

prompt.en: where did bajie and wujing try to lead the demon?
prompt.zh: 八戒和悟净试图把恶魔引到哪里？

answer_evidence.quote: After a few minutes, Bajie pretended to be scared.
He swam upward, and Wujing soon followed.
"Cowards!" called the demon, swimming after them toward the surface.
The demon jumped out of the water and onto the ice.
